FCFS runs A on [0,6), B on [6,8), and C on [8,9). Completion times in A,B,C order are 6,8,9; no job executes before its arrival.

Response means first dispatch minus arrival, not completion or visible application output. Here responses are 0,5,6; their mean is 11/3 ms.
